meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a local server when available and offering an evaluation server when none exists.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给 Mattermost 添加机器人频道,自动复用本地或评估服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队用 Mattermost 需要快速接入机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Add a Mattermost bot channel, auto-reusing local or evaluation server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Mattermost and needs to quickly add a bot channel

howto.what: 把自建或云端的 Mattermost 加为 Claude 的聊天渠道:它会先探测本机已有的可用服务器;找不到时,会在征求同意后部署一台本地评估服务器。接通后,你可以在 Mattermost 私信/频道/线程里收发消息和文件,并处理审批卡片。
howto.when: 当你想把自建或云端的 Mattermost 接成 Claude 的聊天渠道,例如说“添加 Mattermost”或“接入 Mattermost”时,该流程会开始执行。

say.text: 帮我把我的 Mattermost 接到 Claude 上。
添加 Mattermost,但我本地没有服务器,建一台评估用的。
say.note: 开始前会先说明要创建的网络、端口和配置文件,等你确认。

say.text: 接入 Mattermost,服务器地址我在向导里告诉你。
say.note: 会引导你走完设置 SiteURL、填入机器人令牌等步骤。

howto.what_en: Adds Mattermost (self-hosted or cloud) as a chat channel for Claude. It finds a usable local server or offers to create an evaluation server with your approval. Once connected, it enables DMs, channel/thread messages, files and approval cards through that Mattermost.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add or connect Mattermost as a Claude channel, e.g. 'add Mattermost' or 'connect my Mattermost server'. If no usable local server is found, it offers creating an evaluation server after your approval.

say_en.text: Connect my existing Mattermost server to Claude.
Add Mattermost, but create a local evaluation server since I don't have one.
say_en.note: Nothing is created until you approve the Docker setup it describes.

say_en.text: Add Mattermost; I will give the server URL during the wizard.
say_en.note: You'll be guided through server choice, SiteURL, bot token and more.
